component.summary: Every zypper feature in a window
Totes les funcions de zypper en una finestra
Alle Funktionen von zypper in einem Fenster
Toutes les fonctions de zypper dans une fenêtre

description.p: Zypp Desk is a graphical front end for zypper, the package manager of openSUSE, that keeps the whole power of zypper and always shows the exact command and zypper's own output.

ul.li: Search, install and remove packages, upgrade the distribution, with a simulation first
Your applications in one list, from the repositories, from Flatpak or from the web
Discover programs by theme in the openSUSE and Flathub catalogues
Follow programs installed from files published on the web and get their new versions
Repositories with a health check, locks, languages, history and maintenance
Warnings explained in plain words, with how serious they are

description.p: Routines run zypper without questions, programs from the web can be simulated, and fixes from a review.
Applications by origin, discover by theme, more kinds of web source, repository health check and an online search in the openSUSE Build Service, Fedora COPR and Flathub.
German and French translations, and fixes from a review.
